definitions.explanation: Wet, soft earth. Also used in compounds and idioms related to being dirty or in difficult situations.

examples.english: I got mud on my shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{泥|どろ}んこ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んでいる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: The children are playing in the mud.
examples.notes: ⟦{泥|どろ}んこ→泥んこ：noentry⟧ = muddy, mud play

examples.english: After the rain, the road became covered in mud.
examples.notes: {泥|どろ}⟦だらけ→だらけ：18372_darake⟧ = covered in mud

examples.japanese: ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{泥|どろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{汚|よご}れてしまった→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧。
examples.english: My clothes got dirty with mud.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{泥|どろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{茶色|ちゃいろ}く→茶色：02915_chairo⟧⟦{濁|にご}っていた→濁る：02135_nigoru⟧。
examples.english: The river water was brown and muddy from the heavy rain.

notes:
USAGE: {泥|どろ} is used both literally for mud and in various compounds and expressions.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{泥棒|どろぼう}→泥棒：01688_dorobou⟧ (thief, burglar)
- {泥|どろ}⟦だらけ→だらけ：18372_darake⟧ (covered in mud)
- ⟦{泥|どろ}んこ→泥んこ：noentry⟧ (muddy, playing in mud)
- ⟦{泥沼|どろぬま}→泥沼：11065_doronuma⟧ (quagmire, swamp; figuratively: messy situation)
- ⟦{泥酔|でいすい}→泥酔：14732_deisui⟧ (dead drunk - different reading)
- ⟦{泥試合|どろじあい}→泥試合：noentry⟧ (mud-slinging, dirty competition)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {泥|どろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (to disgrace, bring shame upon)
- {泥|どろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かぶる→かぶる：00709_kaburu⟧ (to take the blame, take responsibility)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧ (earth, soil - dry)
- {泥|どろ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧: {泥|どろ} is wet and muddy, ⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧ is dry soil/earth
